Commissioner, is present in the Court today, and 
he says that the amount of VAT due is Rupees 
Thirty Five Crore, and One Time Settlement offer 
was given to the revisionist. The revisionist has 
not accepted the same.
4. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits 
that they are not ready to go for One Time 
Settlement scheme, as they are disputing the 
VAT amount itself. By civil miscellaneous 
application, they have given their synoposis in 
detail. The same is taken on record. 
5. Learned counsel for the State seeks time to 
file counter affidavit to this synoposis. 6. List on 22.07.2024.
7. Personal appearance of the officer is 
exempted.
